entries.description: One static logistics picking-preparation worktable scene, not a new bin family. entries.title: Ramped Small Railway Platform Stop
entries.description: One static railway small-platform-stop scene under the original railway scene program, one scene and zero new independent models. A scene-only grounded pad supports the composition. The ramp approaches the platform lengthwise and its entire low4cm entrance lip remains unchanged; the full bench faces the track, with original edge-contact feet on the actual slab top. The broad ramp stays50mm outside the actual sleeper envelope and the signal plinth remains230mm outside on the opposite side. These are static measured separations, not accessibility or railway engineering requirements. All original meshes and triangles/per-face opaque PBR are retained under declared rigid placements; repeated track materials are reused. Total25meshes2696tri18materials. No train, roof, people, operational signalling, gauge/network connection guarantee, moving points, passenger boarding, accessible safe route, platform installation, collision/navigation, structural-load or railway-safety certification. entries.description: One static cutaway maintenance-hangar scene for the original light-aviation program. A complete open worktable carries one complete existing transport wheel chock as a stored spare; a whole tailwheel towbar is parked separately in the right work strip, not attached or asserted compatible with the plane. Conservative entry, middle, rear and side empty strips remain connected through the real portal openings. The roof is deliberately omitted for display. Different from the original four-tile parking corner: two portal bays and a separate parts-worktable/towbar work strip establish a maintenance layout. One scene, zero new independent models. entries.title: Fixed Guarded Railway Service Crossing
entries.description: One static railway service-road crossing scene under the original railway scene program, one scene and zero new independent models. One complete original2m straight track, one complete unlit signal and one whole double-sided road barricade retain original meshes, unit scale and per-face PBR under rigid placements. Scene-only geometry supplies the grounded pad and three full crossing-road bodies: central slab bears on the two existing middle sleepers, and each outer slab is integral with a descending side approach to ground. Two real longitudinal slots keep the actual rails unfilled; deck top matches original rail-head top within binary32 precision and slot sides retain nominal50mm rail-head clearances. The whole barricade stands on flat ground beyond the east descent, showing a closed static service approach, not an operable gate. Original track is not shortened, recolored, rescaled or split. This crossing intersection differs from the trolley inspection siding and parallel ramped passenger platform. No working signal, vehicle, train, moving barriers, guaranteed wheel/gauge clearance, real traversability, network connection, track operation, load or railway safety suitability. Preview ground is not an exported part.

entries.title: Framed Panel Display Room
entries.description: One static framed-panel display room for the original painting works-display scene program. entries.title: Fruiting Strawberry Runner Plant
entries.description: One newly authored whole low fruiting strawberry-like plant: compact upright crown with three complete trifoliate serrated-leaf petioles, a hanging downward-tapered seeded fruit and five true calyx blades, one small attached flower, and one continuous thin runner to a rooted daughter crown with its own trifoliate rosette. entries.title: Fixed Dual-Link Sampling Rover
entries.description: One original static sampling-rover visual for the approved space-base sampling-vehicle theme. A new low chamfered chassis contains a real offset rear open-top receiver well with full walls and floor. Each side has its own continuous angular main carrier linking the forward wheel, elevated chassis node and a separate two-wheel rear carrier in a second plane; six complete beveled faceted wheels with integral hubs attach through six individual short connectors, not two old full-width axles. A complete new front tower has two sloping mount cheeks, separate rails, an upper cross-member, fixed projecting carriage and a genuine downward-open finite-walled coring-looking shell with blind upper roof. This is not an old four-wheel inspection rover plus an extracted arm, a widened cargo robot, an old trike with extra wheels, a landing strut reused as a drill, or a wheel-count/colour variant. Every chassis, carrier outline, receiver cavity, wheel/hub profile, tower and coring shell is newly authored; generic mesh orientation/ear clipping and mature export/render tooling only are reused. Twenty-eight closed editable meshes and four constant opaque matte/satin PBR roles. One whole prop, zero scenes and no separately counted parts. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, complete horizontal bounds-centred origin and all six finite wheel tread soles at Z0. Fixed decorative game-art only: solid static connectors have no working pivot bores, bearings, steering, differential, suspension travel or terrain adaptation. No actual driving, drilling, extraction, sample capture, powered actuation, autonomous sensing, space qualification, rig, animation, traction, stability, load, safety or engineering performance claim. The receiver is empty and the coring mouth is held above the floor; no ground, sample, logo, real mission or scene.
